project.name: AOS

aos4_independent_verification.attempt_5_cli_provenance_independent_rev: GPT-5.6 Sol using direct GitHub canonical commit, proof, state/evidence, and exact-SHA CI evidence
aos4_independent_verification.attempt_4_independent_review_verifier: GPT-5.6 Sol using direct GitHub canonical forensic evidence and exact-SHA CI
aos4_independent_verification.attempt_4_remediation_independent_review: GPT-5.6 Sol using direct GitHub canonical commit, file, diff and exact-SHA CI evidence

accepted_gates.name: Foundation & Charter
accepted_gates.reopen_condition: Authoritative contradiction in the foundation charter, repository integrity, or accepted governance baseline

accepted_gates.name: Canonical Memory & Schemas
accepted_gates.reopen_condition: Schema breakdown, invalid memory contract, or evidence contradiction.

accepted_gates.name: Shadow Orchestrator
accepted_gates.reopen_condition: Authoritative contradiction in provider routing, shadow decision integrity, canonical policy validation, exact-revision proof, or accepted runtime evidence.

accepted_gates.name: Controlled Single-Worker Execution
accepted_gates.reopen_condition: Authoritative contradiction in machine capability, canonical execution-base authority, structured worker-result integrity, scope/Git containment, LIVE_GUARD behavior, deterministic verification, or accepted AOS-3 runtime evidence.

accepted_gates.name: Independent Verification & HOLD
accepted_gates.reopen_condition: Authoritative contradiction in independent-verifier fail-closed behavior, candidate/evidence binding, required scenario behavior, exact-revision integrity, or accepted AOS-4 evidence.

accepted_gates.name: Distributed Multi-PC Coordination
accepted_gates.reopen_condition: Authoritative contradiction in multi-PC coordination, lease ownership/expiry, distributed backend, machine identity, pair verification, or canonical Git isolation.
